notes:
What's new

• Volume, pitch and speed for each voice: make one voice louder, softer, higher or slower so all your voices sound balanced.
• Simpler Voices section: tap a voice to choose it, its language, or its volume, pitch and speed.
• Improved Dhivehi dictionary: corrected sounds for several letters, clearer letter and fili names.
• Arabic correction dictionaries now keep whole words and verses together, so Quran reading stays smooth.
• Each dictionary can have its own voice, and its voice settings are kept when you export and share it.
• Fancy letters (like 𝗛𝗘𝗟𝗟𝗢) are now read as normal words.
• Better problem reports: a reading that stopped is remembered, so problems are easier to find. Your text is never included.
